name: mcp-zenml
description: MCP server to connect an MCP client with your ZenML MLOps and LLMOps pipelines
long_description: The server provides compact generic tools for discovering, reading, creating, updating, deleting, and running finite actions on supported ZenML resources. It also retains focused tools for diagnostics, active context, pipeline triggering, logs, step code, and interactive Apps. Operators can select a legacy tool-name profile or enforce read-only access independently.

zenml_store_url.title: ZenML Server URL
zenml_store_url.description: The URL of your ZenML server (e.g., https://your-server.cloudinfra.zenml.io)

tools.name: diagnose_zenml_setup
tools.description: Diagnose ZenML MCP server setup (env vars, connectivity, auth, versions).

tools.name: get_step_logs
tools.description: Get the logs for a specific step run.

tools.name: zenml_describe_resources
tools.description: Discover supported generic ZenML resources or one operation schema.

tools.name: zenml_list_resources
tools.description: List one allowlisted ZenML resource type with validated filters.

tools.name: zenml_get_resource
tools.description: Get one allowlisted ZenML resource by its identifier.

tools.name: zenml_create_resource
tools.description: Create one allowlisted ZenML resource with a strict typed payload.

tools.name: zenml_update_resource
tools.description: Update one exact UUID through an allowlisted operation-specific payload.

tools.name: zenml_delete_resource
tools.description: Delete or archive one exact UUID using bounded destructive options.

tools.name: zenml_action_resource
tools.description: Run one finite ZenML lifecycle or relation action.

tools.name: trigger_pipeline
tools.description: Trigger a pipeline to run from the server.

tools.name: get_deployment_logs
tools.description: Get logs for a specific deployment.

tools.name: get_step_code
tools.description: Get the code for a step.

tools.name: open_pipeline_run_dashboard
tools.description: Open an interactive dashboard of recent ZenML pipeline runs.

tools.name: open_run_activity_chart
tools.description: Open an interactive chart showing pipeline run activity over the last 30 days.

prompts.name: stack_components_analysis
prompts.description: Analyze the stacks in the ZenML workspace.
prompts.text: Please generate a comprehensive report or dashboard on our ZenML stack components, showing which ones are most frequently used across our pipelines. Include information about version compatibility issues and performance variations.

prompts.name: recent_runs_analysis
prompts.description: Analyze the recent runs in the ZenML workspace.
prompts.text: Please generate a comprehensive report or dashboard on our recent runs, showing which pipelines are most frequently run and which ones are most frequently failed. Include information about the status of the runs, the duration, and the stack components used.
